opening.argument: The speakers advertise substantial ETH earnings, then direct viewers to contact a Forsage partner, choose levels, and register to build ETH. They explain that participants pay ETH to activate purchased levels and can earn when sales are generated by their team; sales above activated levels roll up. These conditions make the claimed earnings dependent on level purchases and subsequent team sales, not simply on the displayed figures. Yet the presentation also says there is no risk because there is no investing. It does not establish typical returns, verify the displayed balance, or resolve those payment and team-sales conditions. The earnings claims and recruitment path therefore warrant scrutiny alongside the unresolved mechanics and assurances.
